2. Short facts leading to this Rule are that on 7-5-2003 opposite party No.1 as informant lodged a first information report with the Rajbari Police Station against Md Jalaluddin and thirteen others for the commission of offence prescribed in sections 143, 148, 448, 341, 323, 324, 326, 307, 379, 380, 506 Part II, 427 and 114 of the Penal Code. The case was registered as Rajbari Police Station Case No. 7 dated 7-5-2003 corresponding to GR Case No. 108 of 2003. 

 3. The Police after investigation submitted charge sheet under sections 143, 148, 448, 323, 324, 326, 307, 380, 506 Part II, 427 and 114 of the Penal Code accusing nine accused, however submitted final report in favour of the accused petitioners.
